offered_knowledge.title: Send requested security or compliance documents before proposing a review meeting

guidance.summary: When a security or platform reviewer asks for documents, send exactly what was asked with a light ask; let the reviewer set the review timing after reading.
do: send the requested documents in the reply
leave review timing to the reviewer
dont: propose a specific review date in the same message
schedule a meeting before the documents are read
